question: For what purpose do worshippers act amid the thirty-six principles?
premises: Agitation of thirty-six principles shines there.
It is for full Shiva entry into the universe.
Those who worship act for this.
inference: Worship aims at full Shiva entry into the universe.
plain_english: The agitation of thirty-six principles, where it shines, is for full Shiva-entry into the universe; those who worship.
